title: Tell us what is missing
intro: Something you wish Horizon did, something that went wrong, or an idea: it goes straight to the people building Horizon.
placeholder_missing: For example: I wish I could see my credit card bills next to my bank accounts.
placeholder_problem: What did you do, what happened, and what did you expect? (Please do not paste account numbers.)
placeholder_idea: What would make Horizon more useful for you?
mayReply: You may email me about this (at the email I signed in with).
privacy: We keep your message with your account so we can follow up. It is never shared or sold.
thanksBody: We read every message. If you said we may reply, we may email you.
errTooMany: That is a lot of feedback at once: please wait a while before sending more.
errFailed: Could not send it. Please try again.
